last_summary: v1 contains a rooftop fall, shattered glass, a stretcher, a crouching man beside a body, a syringe drawing liquid from a vial, and a silicone mask on a tray. v2 shows a dark pavement close-up, police/courtroom references, delayed vindication for a detective, and a cemetery headstone. The best-supported missing-interval explanation is a staged death using medical props, though explicit application of the props to the fallen man is not visually confirmed.
